event_name: Cody Park Train Wreck Doubles Presented by Prodigy Discs
event_description: BYOP doubles tournament. If you do not have a partner, please sign up and we will work to find you a partner. Two rounds played with the first round being a best shot format and second round being alternate shot. Players meeting at 8:30 AM. 2 teams per card. May use Udisc or a card to keep track of scores. Shotgun start at 9:00 AM for Round 1. Lunch Anticipated at 12PM-1PM Second round shotgun start from 1PM-3PM Prizes and raffle ticket items at 3:30PM. Divisions can be signed up based on ratings: Each division will play a unique setup of the standard Cody Park Train Wreck Course. Pro (RPA Gold): Any player with PDGA >950 or team combination of >1850 Advanced Amateur (RAH blue): Any player with PDGA < or = 950 or team combination of >1820 Intermediate Amateur (RAD white): Any player with PDGA < or = 920 or team combination of >1750 Novice Amateur (RAE red): Any player with PDGA < or = 875 or a team combination of <1750 All cash payouts for each division for the top 40% of teams. All money paid into the tournament will go to the players except 2$ from each player which will purchase raffle tickets for Charity and a chance to get a brand new Prodigy disc golf bag. You can purchase additional raffle tickets as well for more items. Charity funds will be going to Women's Resource Center of North Platte- Provides free obstetric care for families in need in North Platte as well as classes to create stronger and healthier families in North Platte. The event will be sponsored by Prodigy Discs and North Platte Chain Bangers will be selling discs for the tournament- Any disc with the Cody Park Train Wreck Logo purchased will provide charity dollars to the Women's Resource Center. Learn more and register now at https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/Cody_Park_Train_Wreck_Doubles_2026 !

event_name: Celtic Christmas
event_description: Prepare to be enchanted with some of the world's finest Irish dancers and musicians bringing the spirit of Christmas to life! Pals Brewing Company will be serving beer, wine, and liquor. Concessions will be available for sale (Popcorn, Candy, Chocolate) and Coca-Cola drink products. Direct from New York’s Off-Broadway and London’s West End, the internationally acclaimed A Taste of Ireland Company presents its holiday spectacular, A Celtic Christmas . Featuring former World Irish dance champions and stars from Lord of the Dance and Riverdance, A Celtic Christmas delivers a holiday celebration packed with Irish wit, traditional tunes and heartfelt ballads, alongside all your favorite carols. The show’s exciting mix of electrifying rhythms and extraordinary talent promises an evening brimming with Irish charm and enthralling entertainment, all in one powerhouse event. A Celtic Christmas is the gift nobody expects but everyone remembers. The night out you’ve been meaning to book. The memory you’ll make with the people you love most. Whether you’ve got Irish in your blood, Ireland on your bucket list, or you’re experiencing an Irish Christmas for the first time, A Celtic Christmas is the holiday spectacular you won’t forget. Don’t miss your chance to see this magical show as it tours this year for a strictly limited season. Get your tickets now at https://www.eventbrite.com/e/a-celtic-christmas-by-a-taste-of-ireland-tickets-1991757519357 before they sell out.

event_name: Christmas at the Cody's at Buffalo Bill State Historic Park
event_description: “Buffalo Bill” Cody and his wife Louisa loved to entertain for the holidays in their beautiful mansion. Today the community of North Platte keeps the tradition alive with Christmas at the Cody’s. Every nook and cranny of the Cody mansion is filled with holiday cheer, the barn is equally as festive, and the grounds are lit up from top to bottom! Cider, cookies, and roasted chestnuts are served in a recreation of Christmas past. Horse drawn rides and carolers will keep you warm and toasty no matter the weather. Create the perfect holiday tradition with your family at Christmas at the Cody’s! For 2026 Christmas at the Cody's will be the evenings of December 11th, 12th, 13th, 18th, 19th, & 20th. 5:30pm-8:00pm. Admission for adults is $10 per person. Kids ages 5-12 are $5 per person. Ages 4 and under are free. A Nebraska Game and Parks Permit is required to park on the grounds and will be available on site via check or cash.
